requiredFeatures.description: Feature names this caller requires; the request fails when the harness does not declare them.

operation.description: Operation to perform: handoff, spawn, status, message, cancel/stop, list or capabilities.

operationId.description: Caller-chosen idempotency key; reusing it with different input is rejected.

target.description: Target agent: "self" for this session or an owned executor id.

owner.description: For list: only return executors created by this owner identity.

mode.description: Handoff mode: restart (default) starts a fresh context containing only the task material with no summary; compact is an explicit opt-in that keeps a harness-generated history summary.

surface.description: Interaction surface: preserve (default) or an explicit cross-surface target.

task.description: Seed material for handoff, spawn or message: the task the context or executor adopts.

model.description: Optional model override; when omitted the harness configuration is inherited.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning-effort override (for example low, medium, high); when omitted the harness configuration is inherited.

policy.description: Child policy for spawned executors; a denial returns forbidden.

allowSelfHandoff.description: Whether a spawned executor may renew its own context (default true).

allowSpawnChildren.description: Whether a spawned executor may create further executors (default false).

allowSelfStop.description: Whether a spawned executor may stop itself (default true).

isolation.description: Executor isolation: inherit the caller environment (default) or isolated.

count.description: Number of detached executors to spawn (1-16).

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds for a stop confirmation.

reason.description: Human-readable reason recorded with the operation.
